name: onwa-marketplace
description: ONWA Unified Marketplace - One marketplace. Endless possibilities.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @onwa/api && npm run build -w @onwa/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @onwa/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @onwa/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @onwa/api && npm run typecheck -w @onwa/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w @onwa/shared && npm test -w @onwa/api
